bifrost: springboard/src/net/ (wifi.rs, wifi_config.rs, wpa.rs, dhcp.rs, wifi_event.rs), springboard/netd/src, springboard/src/shell/pages.rs (PageId::Vpn)
summary: BifrOSt has a system-level Wi-Fi client (wpa_supplicant control, saved networks, DHCP, DNS from the lease written to resolv.conf) but no app-facing Network Extension API. There is no VPN client, tunnel, relay, content filter, URL filter, DNS proxy or local push; the VPN settings page is a static placeholder showing Not Connected.

features.note: Saved networks are written as wpa_supplicant blocks with priority ordering (move_network, upsert). Only the shell can use them; no SDK API exposes a join or add-configuration call to apps.

features.bifrost: none found (no hotspot or tethering code under springboard/src or springboard/sdk/src)
features.note: No hotspot subsystem and no API for apps to hook into one.

features.feature: Configuring a Wi-Fi accessory to join a network
features.note: Accessory onboarding flow is not built. The network-config primitives exist only inside the shell.

features.apple: Personal VPN collection group (NEVPNManager, NEVPNProtocol, NEVPNError)
features.note: Wave 2 (theme-06, parity/integration e52c2fd0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. The VPN & Device Management page is a static placeholder ('VPN' value 'Not Connected'). No VPN profile storage, no IKEv2 or IPsec client.

features.feature: Packet tunnel provider and app proxy provider (custom VPN)
features.apple: Packet tunnel provider, App proxy provider, NEAppProxyUDPFlowHandling, NETunnelProviderError
features.note: Wave 2 (theme-06, parity/integration e52c2fd0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No extension point for a system-level VPN client and no flow or packet API. The NetworkExtension app-extension host (NEAppExtensionConfiguration) is not present.

Wave 2 (theme-06, parity/integration e52c2fd0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. Depends on the VPN tunnel above; no routing policy layer.
No HTTP/2 or HTTP/3 relay configuration. The browser at springboard/src/shell/browser/doc.rs does its own requests and is not a system proxy.
No on-device flow filter. The only content blocking seen is the browser's own CSS and element handling, not a network filter.
No URL analysis or filtering layer.
The DHCP-supplied resolvers are applied to the system. No DoH or DoT configuration, no user-set DNS profile and no API for apps.
No on-device DNS proxy extension point.
The notification path in springboard/src/shell/usernotif.rs is local to the shell and has no network-independent push channel.

features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/intents.rs is the App Intents layer, not an extension host for network providers
features.note: No Network Extension app-extension host. Apps cannot ship a network provider.

features.apple: Structures, variables and enumerations listed on the landing page
features.note: Wave 2 (theme-06, parity/integration e52c2fd0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. Errors are internal to the Wi-Fi code. No SDK error types for network extensions.

gaps: No VPN client or tunnel: no IKEv2, IPsec, WireGuard or custom packet-tunnel provider, and the VPN settings page is a static placeholder.
No app-facing Wi-Fi configuration API (NEHotspotConfiguration equivalent): join and add-network are shell-only.
No content filter, URL filter or DNS proxy extension points for apps.
No system-wide encrypted DNS (DoH or DoT) settings; only DHCP-supplied resolvers are applied.
No network relay (HTTP/2 or HTTP/3 proxying) configuration.
No hotspot helper or tethering subsystem.
No local push connectivity when the internet is unavailable.
